params.name: payment_account_type
params.description: The payment account type to lookup for

params.name: bank_id
params.description: If payment_account_type is BANK_ACCOUNT, this will be a mandatory field representing the bank id (bnk-xxx) used to identify which bank the account number belongs to

params.name: accountNumber
params.description: The account number, that is either the mobile money number or bank account number

params.name: operator
params.description: If payment_account_type is MOBILE_MONEY, this will be a mandatory field representing the mobile money operator

items.docs:
The lookup resource facilitates the retrieval of metadata associated with mobile money or bank accounts. For instance, prior to creating payment accounts, you can utilize this endpoint to validate whether an account number corresponds to a specific business or individual.
